answer: For a poll predicting whether the sable statue will be moved from the atlas terrace this month, the server locks $10 per ballot and rejects unfunded ballots. After month-end, it checks the official relocation record, refunds deposits on correct predictions, and forfeits the rest. Extra ballots tie up more money and risk loss. The record may be wrong, and wealthy voters can submit many ballots; deposits do not establish identity.
